The apartment

An entire first-floor apartment in a quiet five-storey building, with easy access up to your door.

Living, dining and kitchen area

Japandi-style apartment with private balcony

Entire apartment · Sleeps 4 · 2 bedrooms · 2 beds · 1 bathroom

Soft whites, natural timber and sage green accents give the apartment a warm, hotel-like feel. It suits a long flight, a work trip or a few days in the city. Mascot Station, Sydney Airport and the CBD are all close.

Check dates

Bedrooms

Queen bed in the main bedroom and a king single in the second, both with hotel-quality linen and bedside lighting.

Kitchen and laundry

Gas stove, oven, microwave, dishwasher, rice cooker and cookware. In-unit laundry with dryer, detergent provided.

Living and outdoors

Large smart TV, a dining table for four, and a private balcony over a courtyard. Guests can also use the BBQ area.

Comfort

Walk-in rain shower, towels and toiletries, reverse-cycle air conditioning and heating, fast Wi-Fi and a dedicated workspace.

Meet your hosts

Hi, we’re Ryan and Chelsea. As Sydney locals and travel enthusiasts, we created BTRstays to offer stylish, memorable stays.

We focus on the little details that make a big difference: properties that are clean, welcoming, practical and thoughtfully designed. Whether you’re in Sydney for work or a holiday, we want your stay to be comfortable and stress-free.

Common questions

How do I book?

Choose your dates at the top of the page. We’ll open the listing on Airbnb with your dates filled in, where you can see live availability and book securely.

How does check-in work?

Check-in and check-out are self-service with a smart lock. We send your entry details before you arrive.

Can I book for two weeks or longer?

Yes. For stays of 14 nights or more, we recommend a mid-stay cleaning. You can choose a Refresh & Restock and Full Clean for $250.

What is provided?

Linen, towels, toiletries, laundry detergent and dish soap are all included, plus a fully equipped kitchen.

Are parties or events allowed?

No. Parties and events of any kind are not permitted. Please read the house rules before you book.

How many guests can stay?

The apartment sleeps up to 4 guests across two bedrooms.

Contact us

Have a question before you book, or need a hand during your stay? Get in touch and we’ll reply within an hour. To see live availability and pricing, check your dates on Airbnb.
